hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: Zero builds: run `python tools/gdl/savedregs.py game/game/player do_players --uses` and compare the two assignments. If the seventeen ours-side saved registers map one-to-one onto the target's sixteen plus the known potionicon_tab cache — that is, if no OTHER local differs in whether it is saved — then there is no second value to shed, the save-set delta is fully explained by an axis already measured dead, and this hypothesis is closed without a build. If instead a local is callee-saved on our side and not on the target's, that local names the lever, and the counter-form is to narrow its live range (declare it inside the block that uses it) rather than to touch the potionicon_tab base at all.

hypothesis.statement: do_players is now known to sit at a REGISTER-PRESSURE local optimum, and the one lever that would move it is the save set, not any individual cluster. Three independent probes across two runs have now produced the same signature: an edit closes real, named target structure at its site and LOSES fuzzy function-wide (probe A closes both twins, 97.2692 -> 96.8433; probes I/J of the twice-superseded loop-head record reach EXACT instruction count T1174/O1174 and 97.2692 -> 96.8458/96.9055; probe O of this record reproduces the target's add/lwz/addi trio at 0x10e0 exactly and reads 96.7155). The common cause is measurable in one command and is stated in the twice-superseded record's own zero-build census: our save set is r15-r31 (17 registers, frame 264) against the target's r16-r31 (16, frame 256), and the extra register is the cached `potionicon_tab + 3136` web. Every edit above perturbs that 17-register allocation and the rotation costs more fuzzy than the local structure gains. The untried work is therefore NOT another cluster: it is to shed exactly one long-lived value so the save set becomes r16-r31, and the candidate is NOT the potionicon_tab cache (probes H, I and J already measured that axis dead from three directions) but one of the other long-lived callee-saved webs — census them first with `savedregs.py game/game/player do_players --uses`, which was never run on this function and which prints the local->saved-register assignment for BOTH streams with zero builds.
